rules: This JSON is a GitHub-stored snapshot, not a continuously live agent process.
Proof before status: no test, host action, ACK, deployment or live milestone claim without evidence.
Owner Windows master has sole human authority; local Windows agents execute; ChatGPT and Claude collaborate and review; BFF Linux optional; Z.ai disposable mock-only.
Use normal guarded Git integration to main; worktrees/integrator are optional. Independent review only for real M1 or high-risk changes.
GitHub issues/commits don't wake independent ChatGPT sessions.
No secrets, cookies, credentials, private raw transcripts in GitHub.
operating_policy: Routine Windows coding/testing/reversible diagnostics may proceed directly with normal tool permissions; real authenticated browser/account operations remain subject to the recorded stop order until expressly authorized by owner.
